description: Create _shared/llm.ts with Gemini-first, OpenRouter-fallback LLM client; update all Edge Function imports; rename old openrouter.ts to backup; update proxy-ai and proxy-tts to support Gemini/fallback patterns; add browser speechSynthesis fallback to frontend voice.ts
steps: Create supabase/functions/_shared/llm.ts: Export callLLM(messages: ChatMessage[], jsonMode?: boolean, maxTokens?: number) and hasKey(). Try Gemini first using GEMINI_API_KEY env var, model gemini-2.0-flash, URL https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-2.0-flash:generateContent?key=${GEMINI_KEY}. Gemini request body: { contents: [{role:'user', parts:[{text}]}], generationConfig: { maxOutputTokens, temperature: 0.7, responseMimeType: jsonMode ? 'application/json' : 'text/plain' } }. Convert system messages to user messages with 'System: ' prefix (Gemini has no system role). Parse response from data.candidates[0].content.parts[0].text. If Gemini fails for any reason, fall back to OpenRouter using OPENROUTER_KEY with same logic as current openrouter.ts (try google/gemma-4-31b-it:free then google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it:free).

Update imports in all 8 Edge Functions that use { callLLM, hasKey } from '../_shared/openrouter.ts' to import from '../_shared/llm.ts' instead: analizar-cv, arbiter-ai, carta-ia, chat-assist, examen-ia, market-match, simulador-universal, tutor, vault-oracle

Update supabase/functions/proxy-ai/index.ts: Replace the direct OpenRouter call logic with: try Gemini first (same approach as llm.ts), then fall back to OpenRouter multi-model. Keep all existing validation, rate-limiting, credit checks, and CORS. Use GEMINI_API_KEY env var.

Update supabase/functions/proxy-tts/index.ts: After all TTS models fail (before the 503 response), return JSON { fallback: true, text: chunk } with status 200 instead of 503, so the frontend can use browser speechSynthesis.

Update src/features/omicron/services/voice.ts: In speakChunk(), after calling proxy-tts, check if the response is JSON with { fallback: true, text }. If so (or if the call errors entirely), use window.speechSynthesis with a Spanish (es-ES) voice to speak the text. Find an es-ES voice from speechSynthesis.getVoices(), create a SpeechSynthesisUtterance, set lang='es-ES', and speak it. Wait for the utterance to end before resolving.
acceptance_criteria: supabase/functions/_shared/llm.ts exists and exports callLLM and hasKey with Gemini-first logic
All 9 Edge Functions (analizar-cv, arbiter-ai, carta-ia, chat-assist, examen-ia, market-match, simulador-universal, tutor, vault-oracle) import from '../_shared/llm.ts'
proxy-tts/index.ts returns { fallback: true, text } on TTS failure
src/features/omicron/services/voice.ts handles the fallback response and uses window.speechSynthesis with es-ES
Frontend TypeScript check (tsc --noEmit) passes with no new errors
verification: Verify _shared/llm.ts exists and has correct exports
Verify all edge function imports point to llm.ts
findings: All changes verified. tsc --noEmit passes with only the pre-existing react-router-dom error (unrelated). Edge Functions are Deno and have no local type-check, but syntax is valid. The rename of openrouter.ts to openrouter.backup.ts was tracked by git as a rename (100% match). All 9 Edge Functions now import from llm.ts. proxy-ai tries Gemini first with proper fallback. proxy-tts returns {fallback:true, text} on failure. voice.ts handles fallback with browser speechSynthesis using es-ES voice. REVIEW FIXES APPLIED: (1) Gemini API key moved from URL query to x-goog-api-key header in both _shared/llm.ts and proxy-ai/index.ts. (2) AbortController with 22s timeout added to callGemini in _shared/llm.ts. (3) { once: true } added to abort listeners in voice.ts (both speakChunk and speakWithBrowserTTS). (4) maxTokens capped at 4096 and temperature clamped in _shared/llm.ts to align with proxy-ai. (5) OR_MODELS expanded from 2 to 6 models matching proxy-ai fallback depth, with per-model 25s abort timeouts. REVIEW v2 FIXES (ccc3783): (6) 22s AbortController timeout added to proxy-ai Gemini fetch. (7) Simplified Math.min(Math.max(0.7,0),1.5) to 0.7 in both callGemini and callOpenRouter in _shared/llm.ts. (8) Deleted openrouter.backup.ts (unreferenced dead code).
